title: Database Seeding with Seed Scripts
description: Write automated, repeatable seed scripts in TypeScript to populate development and test databases with realistic data.

data.text: A productive development workflow requires realistic baseline data (sample users, catalog products, organizational roles). Prisma provides a standardized seeding mechanism that executes whenever you run `npx prisma db seed` or `npx prisma migrate reset`.

data.title: package.json Configuration
data.content: Add the prisma.seed field to package.json so the CLI knows how to execute your script using tsx or ts-node.

data.title: prisma/seed.ts
data.content: Using upserts to make seed execution idempotent (safe to run multiple times).

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Configure the seed runner in `package.json` under `"prisma": { "seed": "tsx prisma/seed.ts" }`.
Always use `upsert` in seed scripts to ensure idempotency.
Always call `prisma.$disconnect()` in the `finally` block to close connection pools cleanly.
